intelligence.essence: The Hub is the main public feed for all of NayaNET — the front page of our wisdom network. It's the single intelligent main feed where the most important ideas, stories, and notes from the entire network gather, so everyone can learn from everyone.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the biggest library in the world, where all the best stories and ideas from everyone are gathered in one place — and the librarian knows exactly which book you would love. That's the Hub: everybody's best ideas, all in one place.
intelligence.grandma_view: Imagine the town square, where everyone gathers to share their stories, their wisdom, and their news — and the good stuff rises to the top so nobody misses what matters. That's the Hub: the whole network's front page.
